name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2111: Four findings from the review queue, each verified before acting and all four real. The manual relaunch refused on three job flags but not on the one that means he is filming, while the automatic path has always refused there - the two guarded different things and the weaker one is the one that just got a button. The Grok Eyes card still shipped hidden, so a slow first load still opened an empty drawer. The dash reserved a scrollbar gutter it no longer needed - the last 15px of the gap he reported. And the Cloudflare prompt, a SECOND prompt for the same model, still told it the Chronicle was out of 100 twice; I swept the board and the console for that literal and never thought to sweep the function.
